project: Real-Data E2E Loop B: Run Lifecycle + Report Contract
overview: Normalize run state transitions and report row generation so dev report outputs are sourced from real step outcomes instead of seeded fallback rows.
goals: Ensure run states are deterministic and observable.
Ensure report rows represent real workflow outputs.
Preserve fail-closed behavior without placeholder synthesis as a default success path.
nonGoals: Citation rendering and export blocking contract work (Loop C scope).
Broad review/chat UX polish outside run/report correctness.
successMetrics: Run state progression is deterministic for target packs with no invalid transitions.
Report rows map to real run outputs for pack_01_clean, pack_04_multi_parcel, and pack_05_partial_release.
Seeded fallback report writes are absent from successful P0 runs.
openQuestions: Should run-status polling cadence be standardized in this loop or deferred?
Do we need a temporary compatibility shim for any report consumers expecting placeholder rows?

uiNotes: Run progress and terminal-state copy must align with API states.
Report surfaces must show deterministic failed/incomplete error states.
No stale success rows should appear for failed active runs.

importFormat.description: Run/report verification is fixture driven by existing pack manifests and run outputs; no new external import format is introduced.

rules: Run-state transitions must follow a single allowed transition graph.
Report rows must be run-scoped and generated from real step outcomes.
Seeded fallback rows are not allowed on successful real-data runs.
Each story requires one positive and one negative verification path.

stories.title: Run lifecycle state machine is deterministic
stories.description: As an operator, I want run start/progress/terminal states to be consistent so I can trust run status before triage/export actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Run creation returns a stable initial state and progresses through valid transitions only.
Terminal states are explicit and immutable once reached.
Example: a successful run transitions queued to running to completed and exposes state timeline metadata.
Negative: run state must never regress from terminal to non-terminal or oscillate across contradictory states.

stories.title: Report rows are sourced from real step outcomes
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want report rows and statuses to map to real step results so triage decisions reflect actual extraction and verification behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Report rows are generated from persisted run outputs for the selected run.
Row statuses and payload versions match real step results.
Example: pack_05_partial_release yields mixed statuses that remain stable across reloads for the same run.
Negative: seeded fallback placeholder writes from Quick Start are not emitted for successful real-data runs.

stories.title: Run/report failure contracts are explicit to users
stories.description: As an operator, I want run/report failures surfaced with typed reasons so recovery paths are clear.
acceptanceCriteria: Run failures return deterministic error envelopes with stable code fields.
Report retrieval for failed or incomplete runs surfaces a clear recoverable UI state.
Example: failed run shows a typed failure banner while preserving prior completed-run history.
Negative: report surface must not display stale success rows for a failed active run.

inScope: Run start/progress/terminal-state contract normalization for P0 flows.
Report row write/read path alignment to real step outputs.
Removal of seeded/fallback fail-closed placeholder writes from Quick Start critical path.
Pack coverage for pack_01_clean, pack_04_multi_parcel, and pack_05_partial_release.
functionalRequirements: FR-001: Enforce one canonical run-state transition model in run APIs and UI consumers.
FR-002: Persist and expose terminal-state metadata needed for downstream report/export contracts.
FR-003: Report row generation must be run-scoped and sourced from real step outputs.
FR-004: Remove Quick Start seeded placeholder row writes from the critical successful path.
FR-005: Failure envelopes must be typed and safe for UI display without leaking internals.
failureStatesAndUX: Run creation denied: explicit blocked or conflict message with next action.
Run execution failure: deterministic error banner with code and trace id.
Report fetch failure: recoverable empty/error state with retry and run-selection guidance.
metricsLogging: report_state_mismatch_total between run terminal state and report payload state.
rollbackDisablePath: Gate real-run report mapping so it can be toggled off if regressions are detected.
Fallback keeps blocked/default-safe trust and export posture while preserving current behavior.

risks: Hidden fallback branches may still write seeded rows under rare timing or error paths.
Consumers may assume old row status semantics and misrender mixed states.
dependencies: Depends on Loop A readiness decisions for predictable run-start gating.
Unblocks Loop C export/citation contracts that depend on reliable run and report state.

verificationPlan: Execute quick start runs for pack_01_clean and pack_04_multi_parcel and capture run-state timelines.
Compare run outputs to report rows for pack_01_clean, pack_04_multi_parcel, and pack_05_partial_release.
Inject controlled failure path and confirm typed error and recovery UI behavior.
